events.title: Theological Clash in the Bunks
events.description: {actor} and {target} erupted into a bitter dispute over whether the nuclear deluge was divine wrath or atomic incompetence.
events.consequences_description: Mediation required: choose a side, stay neutral, or enforce secular neutrality.

events.title: Refusal of Sentry Arms
events.description: {actor} demanded strict armed muster drills, but pacifist {target} refused to touch firearms, halting preparation.
events.consequences_description: Command dilemma: uphold martial order or accommodate conscientious objection.

events.title: Private Stash Accusation
events.description: {actor} publicly accused {target} of hoarding personal dried fruit while common rations are curtailed.
events.consequences_description: Community trust damaged: confiscate the stash or protect private property rights.

events.title: Blower Filter Omen Dispute
events.description: {actor} hung bone talismans on the air scrubber, prompting {target} to rip them down as dangerous ventilation hazards.
events.consequences_description: Tension over old-world superstition vs empirical maintenance protocol.

events.title: Late-Night Faith Outreach
events.description: Bound by growing mutual respect, {actor} gently shared morning prayers and scriptures with receptive {target}.
events.consequences_description: Potential worldview conversion if affinity and empathy hold firm.

events.title: Appeal to Compassion
events.description: Witnessing the toll of battle, {actor} quietly convinced veteran {target} that peace requires laying down the rifle first.

events.title: Bunker Ideological Split
events.description: The shelter has polarized into two distinct factions: communal collectivists on one corridor, individualist pragmatists on the other.
events.consequences_description: Shelter harmony fractured; requires governance intervention.

events.title: Mediation of the Broken Pact
events.description: Hostility between {actor} and {target} has reached boiling point (-80 affinity), threatening duty operations.
events.consequences_description: Urgent mediation quest unlocked to prevent physical violence in the barracks.
